doc.title: XW101 slides — the track's own hardware (V17 companion)
doc.source: the snooker lane's SNK-R29 declaration (xw101-v17-declaration.json v3 after two refuter passes, 2026-09-07; §R3c.33 at a3b87ec5; Drive ceremony-merge-bf03b289/r33v17/) — split mechanically into this lane's companion forms by the ballreturn lane (order 21 item 2); nothing renamed, retagged or re-read

built_on.scene_tip: bf03b289 (ceremony merge tip; scene bytes identical through HEAD 4424eb84)

doc.note: every mesh is ONE merged object across all six assemblies; V17 measures the ball's closest approach per mesh (ownHardware) — the snooker lane expects the built lower wires 17–28 mm ABOVE the export's wire line mid-run (agreeing at the clamp), the built slide ring OD 96 vs the PHOTO 88 (inside its ±12 band, disclosed)

meshes.name: obPocketTrack
meshes.role: hardware — the ball MUST touch (rides the lower pair)
meshes.physical: the 24 spring-steel wires of the six terminal chutes: per chute 4 wires = two levels × two; each = 30 mm lead under the ring falling 4, straight slope to the clamp, up-turned stop 12 mm before the clamp

tags.wire_od: OPEN 6-9, 7.5 carried (10308) → spell DERIVED(proxy) under the schema
tags.lead_and_stop: DERIVED 30 mm lead falling 4; stop 12 mm before the clamp (28324-28325) — SUPERSEDED by the SNK-R25 read (vertical drop L_v 30 [22,44] from the rim bosses), not yet rebuilt

omissions: no vertical drop from the rim bosses (SNK-R25 L_v 30 [22,44]): the built wires start 0.6·rRing inboard under the ring
the built lower wires run ~20-25 mm ABOVE the export's wire line at mid-run (see seat_consistency)

meshes.name: obSnkSlideRing
meshes.role: hardware — the ball passes THROUGH it (the order's ring)
meshes.physical: the brass slide ring under each bag; the net funnels into it, the wires leave it

tags.plane: PHOTO 162 ±15 under the rail top (SE 151-171, three pockets) (10302)
tags.tube: OPEN — the top ring's tube class; the SE resolves the OD not the section (10304)
tags.built_vs_read: built outer Ø 96 (rim at 48) vs PHOTO OD 88 ±12 — rRing 0.044 is used as the tube-centre radius

omissions: the rim boss-clamps that hold the wires (PHOTO, §R3c.28) are not built

meshes.name: obPocketStrap
meshes.role: hardware — clamp/strap at the run's end (no ball contact in reality; the export's stop station lies inside it, see assemblies)
meshes.physical: the leather strap hanging the clamp from the rail-band underside, outboard of the wires

tags.width_thickness: OPEN W12 montage class; SE reads 30-33 wide (10312)
tags.top: PHOTO SE 126 ±12 under the rail top (§R3c.23.3)
tags.placement: DERIVED: 6 mm inside the wire ends, outboard by gauge/2 + 4 + 12 (28343-28345)

omissions: the clamp BODY gripping the wires is not modelled — it exists only as the 12 mm placement offset (28345)

meshes.name: obPocketStrapIron
meshes.physical: strap keeper + buckle + the four Ø7.2 dome bolts of the clamp plate

tags.bolts: OUR signed drawing GH489-EXT-R1.2 letter E20 (28376-28381) — 'MODEL/DRAWING' in the comment means OUR drawing, not a purchased model

meshes.name: obPocketStrapPlate
meshes.role: hardware — the clamp backplate holding the four wires
meshes.physical: triangular polished-gold clamp backplate, 60 × 94 per the drawing comment (built y-span 85: bbox −316.8…−231.8), with its cut-out, 3 thick

tags.shape: OUR signed drawing GH489-EXT-R1.2 letter E20 (28376-28391); §R3c.23.3: 'PHOTO for the slide furniture … the Magnum has no strap plate' — DRAWING/OURS, not MODEL
tags.placement: DERIVED: 30 above the clamp low point, 1.5 off the strap

omissions: the slide ring's rim boss-clamps holding the wires (PHOTO, §R3c.28)
the clamp body gripping the wires (only a 12 mm placement offset exists)
the wires' vertical drop from the rim (L_v 30 [22,44])

seat_consistency_expected.finding: the BUILT lower wires run 17-28 mm ABOVE the export's wire line along the corner runs (27.6 at x −1760, 25.7 at −1700, 24.3 at −1640, 16.7 at −1580); the ball centre (export line + 26.5) therefore rides THROUGH the drawn wires (dMin ≈ 0, stationsBelowR ≈ all)
seat_consistency_expected.why: the two AGREE at the clamp (render −299.8; the export's stop face is its valley vertex −299.82 at wall_s 289.1 — the −284.82 point is the up-turn's top 19 mm past the stop) and differ in where the run starts: the render leaves 0.6·rRing + 30 under the ring plane −121.8 (slope 56.4 → 264 along the plate axis), the export at −130.05 from 10.3 to 244.3 on a datum 19.7 outboard. Two independent derivations of the same BODY-1 read; both are superseded by the SNK-R25/R27 hand-off (vertical drop, then the run)
seat_consistency_expected.consequence: V17's ownHardware read will report this until the lead+exporter round rebuilds both from the same read; it is not a refusal by their rule

provenance.source: XW101 slide furniture read on the manufacturer side elevation (3.679 mm/px, plank-cap anchors 110.5/1157 px) and the studio frames (SNK lane §R3c.23.3, §R3c.28): ring plane 162 ±15 and OD 88 ±12 under the rail top, clamp low point 340 ±15, runs 276/453/280 ±20-25; sub-dimensions carried as OPEN classes and spelled here per the schema's own rule (PROXY as DERIVED with the proxy stated): wire OD 7.5 (6-9), lower-pair gauge 28 (±30 %), level gap 15 DERIVED (19/110 px × 85); the clamp backplate is OUR signed drawing GH489-EXT-R1.2 letter E20 (not a purchased model). Built on craft-r2 tip bf03b289 (HEAD 4424eb84, identical scene bytes). Every mesh is ONE merged object covering all six assemblies.
